summary: Frontend-only regression for redesign (cream/lime palette, full-bleed hero, floating chatbot, updated bio). All hero/CTA/chatbot/language/testimonial/FAQ/conditions flows pass. One CRITICAL missing render: About section not mounted in App.js.

ui_bugs.issue: About component is not imported or rendered — data-testid='about-section' and credentials-col-0/1/2 are entirely absent from the DOM. Bio (Karolinska, Penn Presbyterian, Swedish Armed Forces, 2013) and credentials block are not displayed to the user. Nav still links to About Me (#about) which will scroll to nothing.

verified_functionality: No runtime error overlay, no console errors on load.
Full-bleed hero: hero-bg-image present, headline 'Clear answers./Precise surgery./Personal care.', lime overline pill, hero-book-btn (tel:+97143775500) and hero-symptom-btn visible over photo.
Nav: transparent over hero, becomes cream/85 with blur+border after scroll (site-nav header class changes).
symptom-checker legacy section is NOT present (correctly removed).
Floating symptom-bot-fab visible bottom-right; opens symptom-bot-panel. hero-symptom-btn also opens the same panel.

Chatbot EN: chip 'gallstones' -> bot-loading -> bot-result (1838 chars, first-person 'I' voice, possible causes/red flags, bot-book-btn present). Text send (bot-input+bot-send) also fetches a response. No bot-error. symptom-bot-close works.
Chatbot AR: after language-switcher -> lang-option-ar, html[dir=rtl] lang=ar; bot returns response in Arabic script (1229 chars).
Language regression: AR -> rtl/ar, SV -> ltr/sv, EN -> ltr/en all working.
condition-toggle-hernia expands/collapses; faq-item-0 expands; testimonial-next changes quote.
Sections present with opacity 1 after reveal: conditions-section, why-choose, journey-section, testimonials-section, articles-section, faq-section, insurance-section, final-cta, site-footer.
CTA hrefs correct: nav-book-btn & hero-book-btn = tel:+97143775500; whatsapp-btn = https://wa.me/97143775500.
action_items: CRITICAL: Import and render <About /> in /app/frontend/src/App.js (e.g., between TrustBar and Conditions or between WhyChoose and PatientJourney). The About component file exists at /app/frontend/src/components/landing/About.js with data-testid='about-section' and credentials-col-{0,1,2}, but it is never mounted. Nav 'About Me' link (#about) currently points to nothing.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js does not import About even though About.js exists — regression from a previous iteration. This causes the bio + credentials block requirement in the review request to fail.
Nav's About Me menu item scrolls to #about which does not exist in the DOM; anchor is dead until About is remounted.

Consider aligning data-testid naming (why-choose-section vs why-choose, journey-section vs patient-journey-section, final-cta vs final-cta-section) to reduce future test churn, but current names are consistent and testable.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all flows pass except About section absent)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Main agent must re-add <About /> to App.js. Once added, re-verify: (a) [data-testid=about-section] visible with bio text containing 'Karolinska', 'Penn Presbyterian', 'Swedish Armed Forces', '2013'; (b) credentials-col-0/1/2 present with Education/Experience/Memberships. Everything else in the redesign (full-bleed hero, floating chatbot EN+AR, language switching, section reveals, testimonial carousel, FAQ accordion, condition toggle, CTA hrefs) is confirmed working.
rca of the issue: App.js only imports Nav, Hero, TrustBar, SymptomBot, Conditions, WhyChoose, PatientJourney, Testimonials, Articles, FAQ, Insurance, FinalCTA, Footer. The About import/render was dropped during the redesign iteration. Fix: add `import About from "@/components/landing/About";` and render `<About />` inside <main>.
